# Review Nurtures
Date: 2026-10-26 | Duration: 42.65999984741211m

## Summary
The team evaluated whether to use separate nurture flows or one controlled cadence, with a preference for centralized HubSpot control to reduce overlapping sends. Onboarding nurture was the highest priority and will incorporate interview requests, clearer persona and license segmentation, live demos, and relevant product links. General nurture was identified as the next design focus, potentially covering recycled leads and long-term event audiences, while post-event sequences remain distinct. Reactivation, closed-lost re-engagement, and product-triggered campaigns were deferred. AI BDR activity remains blocked by incomplete lead scoring, and sales routing still needs rules for priority accounts and hot, warm, and cold event leads. Data limitations include incomplete role information, unavailable product activity data, Rio integration work, and billing data not synchronized with HubSpot. A central repository will track active, historical, and planned nurtures.

## Keywords
Nurture workflows, lead scoring, AI BDR, HubSpot data, onboarding campaigns, reactivation marketing
